name: Lich
location:
Dark Anchors, Dark Fissures
Rimmen Necropolis

abilities.name: Necrotic Spear
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals minor frost damage.

abilities.name: Defiled Ground
abilities.description: The lich casts a rune on the ground, indicated by a red circle, at or near its target's location, which deals continuous fast ticks of direct minor magic damage and snares.

abilities.name: Soul Cage
abilities.description: The lich summons three then five lich crystals from the ground around itself, as indicated by large red circles. Standing near the crystals deals continuous direct low frost damage. This ability is always followed by Soul Rupture.

abilities.name: Soul Rupture
abilities.description: After a short time, the crystals explode, dealing moderate frost damage and briefly lifting all targets within the red circle.

notes: A non-NPC Lich is caged in the Forbidden Exhibit part of The Feral Gallery. It can cast the generic "Soul Cage/Soul Rupture" and "Defiled Ground" lich abilities if you approach its cage. Approaching its cage also allows you to "examine" it with a press of your action button.
Mannimarco and Vastarie are considered liches in lore, but have been excluded from here as they do not function mechanically like a lich.
Liches also have "Flying Immunities" which protects them from snares and roots, but it is bypassed by their elite (and higher) rank immunity which also does this.

summary: This article is about the creature. For the collectible polymorph, see Lich (polymorph). Liches are aggressive undead creatures which attack using powerful spells. Liches are generally not found in the wild, but can occasionally be seen emerging from Dark Anchors and Dark Fissures, present among necromantic organizations or in places teeming with the dead.
